summary: Completed testing of iteration 9 features. Fixed 2 bugs: 1) Missing 'Settings' import in Companies.js causing runtime error, 2) Missing 'codigo_empresa' field in Company model. All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend features verified: Análise Saída menu, company edit button, codigo_empresa field, delete buttons, tipoOperacao filter.

integration_issues.issue: Shows 'Nenhuma empresa cadastrada' on first login even though companies exist. This is a timing issue with AppContext not re-fetching companies after login. Workaround: refresh page or navigate to Companies page first.
